# Technical Foundation (Tier 0)

Establish the technical spine required for FasNexi's MVP and subsequent phases.

Acceptance criteria:
- Monorepo structure exists with server/, app/, design/ directories and a root README describing layout.
- Expo app configured with Nativewind/Tailwind and font loading for Playfair Display & Work Sans.
- Tailwind theme includes color tokens from design/tokens.json and the gold palette constant.
- CI setup skeleton added (lint, typecheck, test stub).

Success metric: repo skeleton ready for engineering on Day 1; initial CI passes.
